R5.authority_limit: A read-only observation grants no custody or updater authority. The updater must re-prove the conditions while retaining custody.
R5.observation: The materializer uses the same paired-state and quiescence conditions as U5 and includes the unit cgroup observation.

U5.authorization: The narrow branch requires the validated guard or recovery contract. All four distributed execution bindings remain unbound.
U5.correction: Admit only the paired inactive/dead or failed/failed stopped states, subject to the complete existing native-unit, quiescence and retained-custody checks.
U5.guardrails: No active consumers or pending jobs; empty and absent unit cgroup; absent consumer records; retained custody identities re-proved at every proof. Uncertain release refuses.

finalS3.bundle: Exact final code and its matching adjacent static dependency form the reviewed bundle. Historical receipts do not prove current custody.
finalS3.wrapper_ancestry: The wrapper exemption authenticates the exact pinned ancestry and identities; a process identifier alone is insufficient.

independent_source_review.review_method: Independent actual-source and private-fixture controls; unchanged earlier results retain their original scope.

not_established_by_this_source_review: Current operational admission, live handle and retained-custody proofs, a genuine once-only updater operation or its exact final bound invocation.
Source91 installation or committed update history, supported native startup, runtime READY or authenticated operational acceptance.
A new Jarvis reply, artifact, persistence or contextual follow-up; full B00 or release acceptance.
preserved_failures: The earlier first preflight refusal and the later integrated stopped-state refusal remain closed historical failures; neither operation is replayed or its budget reset.
The historical Source90 application startup failure cause remains unproven. A successful native stop does not establish successful application shutdown.
Earlier B00 component, partial, failure and NOT_RUN observations retain their recorded scopes.
scope: Sanitized independent exact-source review. Current operation, installation and runtime outcomes require separate evidence.
